E1213

Package declared in `packages:` but `module <name>` found in multiple files

What

Package declared in `packages:` but `module <name>` found in multiple files

Why

A package's module is declared in exactly one file, so the build knows where it starts

Fix

Keep exactly one `module <name>` declaration in the package source tree.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1213: tests/ui/manifest_package_ambiguous/stderr.

Error [jet.DuplicatePackageModule]: `package.jet` declares package `hello` but `module hello` is ambiguous
 Why: `module hello` was found in multiple files: a.jet, b.jet; each package name must map to exactly one module
 Fix: Rename one of the conflicting `module hello` declarations so each package has a unique name
